description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.

description.zh:
剪辑结束时间，单位：秒。

> - 剪辑时间取值范围为0到节目总时长。
> - 默认取值为点播文件结束时长，取值不可超出节目的总时长。
> - 如果您想要剪辑一个点播文件，从第2秒到第5秒，那么StartTime取值为2.0，EndTime取值为5.0。
description.en:
The end time of the clip. Unit: seconds.

> - The value must be between 0 and the total duration of the show.
>
> - By default, the clip ends at the end of the VOD file. The value cannot exceed the total duration of the show.
>
> - For example, to clip a VOD file from the 2-second mark to the 5-second mark, set StartTime to 2.0 and EndTime to 5.0.

description.zh:
需要剪辑的节目ID。
>通过查看[AddShowIntoShowList](~~2848051~~)接口的返回参数获取ShowId值。
description.en:
The ID of the show that you want to edit.

> Obtain the ShowId value from the response parameters of the [AddShowIntoShowList](~~2848051~~) operation.

description.zh:
剪辑开始时间，单位：秒。

> - 剪辑时间取值范围为0到节目总时长。- 默认从点播文件开头开始剪辑，取值：0.0。
> - 如果您想要剪辑一个点播文件，从第2秒到第5秒，那么StartTime取值为2.0，EndTime取值为5.0。
description.en:
The start time of the clip. Unit: seconds.

> - The value must be between 0 and the total duration of the show. The default value is 0.0. This means the clip starts from the beginning of the VOD file.
>
> - For example, to clip a VOD file from the 2-second mark to the 5-second mark, set StartTime to 2.0 and EndTime to 5.0.

description.zh:
存储信息。描述：

- **StorageLocation**：用户点播存储地址。
- **FileName**：用户自定义文件名。

>剪辑存储地址必须是用户同一账户下的点播存储地址，获取点播存储地址请参见[存储管理](~~86097~~)。
description.en:
The storage information. Description:

- **StorageLocation**: The storage address for the video-on-demand (VOD) file.

- **FileName**: The custom file name.

> The storage address for the edited video must be a VOD storage address that is under the same account. To obtain a VOD storage address, see [Storage management](~~86097~~).

descriptions.zh:
本接口支持指定CasterId和ShowId添加剪辑任务。
添加剪辑任务成功不会自动通知，您可调用[GetEditingJobInfo](~~2848059~~)接口查询任务状态信息。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation adds a video editing job. You must specify a CasterId and a ShowId. You will not be notified when the video editing job is successfully added. To query the job status, call the [GetEditingJobInfo](~~2848059~~) operation.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.
